metadata.title: Nvidia Stock Keeps Falling as 'Hot Money' Heads Away From AI Chips<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nvidia Stock Keeps Falling as ‘Hot Money’ Heads Elsewhere
Nvidia stock was falling again early Friday. A widespread technology-sector selloff was hitting the chip maker, which is struggling to establish a floor.
